target: 192.168.1.15 (airobots), 56 cores, Anubis v1.28.3, fast d4, challenge-all policy
client: tools/stress_test.c (C, raw HTTP/1.1, libanubis_solver for PoW)
notes: Each cycle is fetch-challenge -> solve -> pass-challenge (server verifies the PoW). The final authenticated GET returns 4xx because the C client's Set-Cookie capture is incomplete, so the reported rate counts challenge+verify cycles, not fully authenticated fetches. 8 workers already saturate the client's per-thread HTTP cost; 128 workers do not raise throughput and only inflate load average with blocked threads. Server CPU stays around 1.7 of 56 cores.
